@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
internal fun TopConfigsSheet(
    topState: TopUiState,
    selectedGuid: String?,
    isTesting: Boolean,
    onAction: (MainAction) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
) {
    ModalBottomSheet(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true),
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
            Text(
                text = stringResource(R.string.spatial_top_configs),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            )
            Text(
                text = stringResource(R.string.top_hint),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp, bottom = 8.dp),
            )

            // Max ping threshold
            ChipRow(label = stringResource(R.string.top_threshold)) {
                listOf(150L, 250L, 400L).forEach { ms ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = topState.maxDelayMillis == ms,
                        onClick = { onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(topState.limit, ms, topState.countryCode, topState.countrySource)) },
                        label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.server_test_delay_value, ms)) },
                    )
                }
            }
            // List size
            ChipRow(label = stringResource(R.string.top_limit)) {
                listOf(30, 50).forEach { n ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = topState.limit == n,
                        onClick = { onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(n, topState.maxDelayMillis, topState.countryCode, topState.countrySource)) },
                        label = { Text(n.toString()) },
                    )
                }
            }
            // Where the country comes from: flag in the name (estimate) or exit IP learned from your own tests
            ChipRow(label = stringResource(R.string.top_country_source)) {
                TopConfigManager.CountrySource.values().forEach { source ->
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = topState.countrySource == source,
                        onClick = {
                            onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(topState.limit, topState.maxDelayMillis, null, source))
                        },
                        label = {
                            Text(
                                stringResource(
                                    if (source == TopConfigManager.CountrySource.NAME) R.string.top_source_name
                                    else R.string.top_source_exit
                                )
                            )
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
            if (topState.countrySource == TopConfigManager.CountrySource.EXIT) {
                Text(
                    text = stringResource(R.string.top_source_exit_hint),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 4.dp),
                )
            }
            val countries = remember(topState.entries, topState.countryCode) {
                (topState.entries.mapNotNull { it.countryCode } + listOfNotNull(topState.countryCode))
                    .distinct().sorted()
            }
            if (countries.isNotEmpty()) {
                ChipRow(label = stringResource(R.string.top_country)) {
                    FilterChip(
                        selected = topState.countryCode == null,
                        onClick = { onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(topState.limit, topState.maxDelayMillis, null, topState.countrySource)) },
                        label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.top_country_all)) },
                    )
                    countries.forEach { code ->
                        FilterChip(
                            selected = topState.countryCode == code,
                            onClick = {
                                onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(topState.limit, topState.maxDelayMillis, code, topState.countrySource))
                            },
                            label = { Text(TopConfigManager.flagEmoji(code) + " " + code) },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            // Any value, not only the presets above
            var delayText by remember(topState.maxDelayMillis) { mutableStateOf(topState.maxDelayMillis.toString()) }
            var limitText by remember(topState.limit) { mutableStateOf(topState.limit.toString()) }
            val delayValue = TopConfigManager.parseMaxDelay(delayText)
            val limitValue = TopConfigManager.parseLimit(limitText)
            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 4.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                verticalAlignment = Alignment.Top,
            ) {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = delayText,
                    onValueChange = { delayText = it },
                    label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.top_threshold)) },
                    isError = delayValue == null,
                    supportingText = { if (delayValue == null) Text(stringResource(R.string.top_invalid_delay)) },
                    singleLine = true,
                    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = limitText,
                    onValueChange = { limitText = it },
                    label = { Text(stringResource(R.string.top_limit)) },
                    isError = limitValue == null,
                    supportingText = { if (limitValue == null) Text(stringResource(R.string.top_invalid_limit)) },
                    singleLine = true,
                    keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Number),
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                )
                TextButton(
                    enabled = delayValue != null && limitValue != null,
                    onClick = {
                        if (delayValue != null && limitValue != null) {
                            onAction(MainAction.SetTopFilter(limitValue, delayValue, topState.countryCode, topState.countrySource))
                        }
                    },
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp),
                ) { Text(stringResource(R.string.top_apply)) }
            }

            Row(
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
            ) {
                TextButton(enabled = !isTesting, onClick = { onAction(MainAction.TestTopConfigs) }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.spatial_test_top))
                }
                TextButton(enabled = !isTesting, onClick = {
                    onAction(MainAction.AutoSelect)
                    onDismiss()
                }) {
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.spatial_auto_select))
                }
            }

            if (topState.entries.isEmpty()) {
                Text(
                    text = if (topState.isLoading) stringResource(R.string.top_loading) else stringResource(R.string.top_none),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    modifier = Modifier.padding(vertical = 24.dp),
                )
            } else {
                LazyColumn(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(380.dp)) {
                    items(topState.entries, key = { it.guid }) { entry ->
                        TopEntryRow(
                            entry = entry,
                            selected = entry.guid == selectedGuid,
                            onClick = {
                                onAction(MainAction.SelectServer(entry.guid))
                                onDismiss()
                            },
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ChipRow(label: String, chips: @Composable () -> Unit) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState())
            .padding(vertical = 2.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp),
    ) {
        Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, modifier = Modifier.width(72.dp))
        chips()
    }
}

@Composable
private fun TopEntryRow(entry: TopConfigManager.Entry, selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .semantics(mergeDescendants = true) { this.selected = selected }
            .clickable(onClick = onClick)
            .padding(vertical = 8.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                text = entry.remarks,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                fontWeight = if (selected) FontWeight.Bold else FontWeight.Normal,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
            val candidate = if (entry.isCandidate) " · " + stringResource(R.string.top_candidate) else ""
            Text(
                text = entry.protocol + " · " + formatAge(entry.lastTestTime) + " · " +
                        stringResource(R.string.top_stability, entry.stability) + candidate,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
            )
        }
        Text(
            text = stringResource(R.string.server_test_delay_value, entry.delayMillis),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
            fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
            modifier = Modifier.padding(start = 8.dp),
        )
    }
}

/** "5 min ago" style age of the stored result, so an old result is never mistaken for a fresh one. */
@Composable
private fun formatAge(lastTestTime: Long): String {
    if (lastTestTime <= 0L) return stringResource(R.string.top_age_unknown)
    val minutes = ((System.currentTimeMillis() - lastTestTime) / 60_000L).coerceAtLeast(0L)
    return when {
        minutes < 60L -> stringResource(R.string.top_age_minutes, minutes)
        minutes < 60L * 24L -> stringResource(R.string.top_age_hours, minutes / 60L)
        else -> stringResource(R.string.top_age_days, minutes / (60L * 24L))
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun AutoSelectDialog(
    proposal: AutoSelectProposal,
    isRunning: Boolean,
    onAction: (MainAction) -> Unit,
) {
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { onAction(MainAction.DismissAutoSelect) },
        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.auto_select_title)) },
        text = {
            Text(
                stringResource(
                    R.string.auto_select_message,
                    proposal.remarks.ifBlank { proposal.guid },
                    proposal.delayMillis,
                )
            )
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(
                onClick = { onAction(MainAction.ApplyAutoSelect(proposal.guid, reconnect = isRunning || proposal.connect)) }
            ) {
                Text(
                    stringResource(
                        when {
                            proposal.connect && !isRunning -> R.string.auto_select_apply_connect
                            isRunning -> R.string.auto_select_apply_reconnect
                            else -> R.string.auto_select_apply
                        }
                    )
                )
            }
        },
        dismissButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = { onAction(MainAction.DismissAutoSelect) }) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.action_cancel))
            }
        },
    )
}

/** Asks before testing more configs when nothing in the top list answered. */
@Composable
internal fun ExpandDialog(
    proposal: ExpandProposal,
    onAction: (MainAction) -> Unit,
) {

        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.auto_select_expand_title)) },
        text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.auto_select_expand_message, proposal.count)) },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = { onAction(MainAction.ConfirmExpand) }) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.auto_select_expand_confirm))
            }
        },
        dismissButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = { onAction(MainAction.DismissExpand) }) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.action_cancel))
            }
        },
    )
}

/**

        // japan
        floatArrayOf(130f, 31f, 135f, 34f, 140f, 36f, 142f, 40f, 141f, 45f, 145f, 43f, 142f, 38f, 140f, 35f, 135f, 33f, 131f, 33f),
        // uk
        floatArrayOf(-5f, 50f, 1f, 51f, 2f, 53f, -2f, 57f, -6f, 58f, -5f, 54f),
        // iceland
        floatArrayOf(-24f, 65f, -14f, 66f, -14f, 64f, -22f, 63f),
        // borneo
        floatArrayOf(109f, 1f, 117f, 7f, 119f, 1f, 116f, -4f, 110f, -3f),
        // sumatra
        floatArrayOf(95f, 5f, 105f, -6f, 103f, -5f, 98f, 1f),
        // new_guinea
        floatArrayOf(131f, -1f, 141f, -3f, 150f, -10f, 141f, -9f, 134f, -4f),
        // madagascar
        floatArrayOf(44f, -25f, 50f, -15f, 49f, -12f, 44f, -17f),
        // new_zealand
        floatArrayOf(172f, -35f, 178f, -38f, 174f, -41f, 166f, -46f, 172f, -41f),
    )

    fun isLand(lonDeg: Float, latDeg: Float): Boolean = polygons.any { contains(it, lonDeg, latDeg) }

    /** Even-odd ray casting. */
    private fun contains(poly: FloatArray, lon: Float, lat: Float): Boolean {
        var inside = false
        val n = poly.size / 2
        var j = n - 1
        for (i in 0 until n) {
            val xi = poly[2 * i]
            val yi = poly[2 * i + 1]
            val xj = poly[2 * j]
            val yj = poly[2 * j + 1]
            if ((yi > lat) != (yj > lat) && lon < (xj - xi) * (lat - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) inside = !inside
            j = i
        }
        return inside
    }
}

/** Points of a Fibonacci sphere with a land flag and longitude each (computed once). */
internal class GlobePoints(val x: FloatArray, val y: FloatArray, val z: FloatArray, val land: BooleanArray, val lonDeg: FloatArray) {
    val size: Int get() = x.size

    companion object {
        /**
         * Longitude 0 faces the viewer (+z) and east points to +x, so with north up the map is not mirrored.
         */
        fun build(count: Int): GlobePoints {
            val xs = FloatArray(count)
            val ys = FloatArray(count)
            val zs = FloatArray(count)
            val land = BooleanArray(count)
            val lons = FloatArray(count)
            val golden = (1.0 + sqrt(5.0)) / 2.0
            for (i in 0 until count) {
                val theta = 2.0 * PI * i / golden
                val phi = acos(1.0 - 2.0 * (i + 0.5) / count)
                val x = (cos(theta) * sin(phi)).toFloat()
                val y = cos(phi).toFloat()
                val z = (sin(theta) * sin(phi)).toFloat()
                xs[i] = x
                ys[i] = y
                zs[i] = z
                val lat = Math.toDegrees(asin(y.toDouble())).toFloat()
                val lon = Math.toDegrees(atan2(x.toDouble(), z.toDouble())).toFloat()
                lons[i] = lon
                land[i] = WorldLandMask.isLand(lon, lat)
            }
            return GlobePoints(xs, ys, zs, land, lons)
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun AppTopBar(
    title: String,
    onBackClick: () -> Unit,
    isLoading: Boolean = false,
    isSearchActive: Boolean = false,
    searchQuery: String = "",
    onSearchQueryChange: (String) -> Unit = {},
    onSearchClose: () -> Unit = {},
    searchPlaceholder: String? = null,
    navigationIcon: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null,
    containerColor: Color? = null,
    actions: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit = {},
) {
    Column {
        TopAppBar(
            title = {
                if (isSearchActive) {
                    SearchInputField(
                        query = searchQuery,
                        onQueryChange = onSearchQueryChange,
                        placeholder = searchPlaceholder
                    )
                } else {
                    Text(text = title)
                }
            },
            navigationIcon = {
                if (navigationIcon != null) {
                    navigationIcon()
                } else {
                    IconButton(onClick = if (isSearchActive) onSearchClose else onBackClick) {
                        Icon(
                            painter = painterResource(R.drawable.ic_arrow_back_24dp),
                            contentDescription = stringResource(R.string.acc_back)
                        )
                    }
                }
            },
            actions = actions,
            colors = TopAppBarDefaults.topAppBarColors(
                containerColor = containerColor ?: MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
                titleContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                navigationIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface,
                actionIconContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
            )
        )
        AnimatedVisibility(
            visible = isLoading,
            enter = expandVertically(),
            exit = shrinkVertically()
        ) {
            LinearProgressIndicator(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary)
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SearchInputField(
    query: String,
    onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit,
    placeholder: String?
) {
    val focusRequester = remember { FocusRequester() }
    LaunchedEffect(Unit) { focusRequester.requestFocus() }
    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = query,
            onValueChange = onQueryChange,
            singleLine = true,
            textStyle = TextStyle(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface, fontSize = 16.sp),
            placeholder = { if (placeholder != null) Text(placeholder, style = TextStyle(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, fontSize = 16.sp)) },
            colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                focusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                unfocusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                focusedBorderColor = Color.Transparent,
                unfocusedBorderColor = Color.Transparent,
                cursorColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
                selectionColors = TextSelectionColors(
                    handleColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
                    backgroundColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
                )
            ),
            keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Search),
            modifier = Modifier
                .weight(1f)
                .focusRequester(focusRequester)
        )
        if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
            IconButton(onClick = { onQueryChange("") }) {
                Icon(painterResource(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_close_clear_cancel), "Clear")
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
fun AppListItem(
    appName: String,
    packageName: String,
    icon: Any?,
    checked: Boolean,
    onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .clickable { onCheckedChange(!checked) }
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 12.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        val model = remember(icon, packageName) {
            if (icon != null) {
                icon
            } else {
                val data = "appicon:$packageName"
                ImageRequest.Builder(context)
                    .data(data)
                    .fetcherFactory(AppIconFetcher.Factory(context))
                    .build()
            }
        }

        AsyncImage(
            model = model,
            contentDescription = null,
            modifier = Modifier.size(40.dp),
            contentScale = ContentScale.Fit,
            error = painterResource(R.drawable.ic_image_24dp),
            fallback = painterResource(R.drawable.ic_image_24dp)
        )
        Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                text = appName,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(2.dp))
            Text(
                text = packageName,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                maxLines = 1,
                overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis
            )
        }
        Checkbox(
            checked = checked,
            onCheckedChange = onCheckedChange,
            colors = CheckboxDefaults.colors(checkedColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary)
        )
    }
}

@Composable
private fun reorderableElevation(isDragging: Boolean) = animateDpAsState(
    targetValue = if (isDragging) 4.dp else 0.dp,
    label = "ReorderableElevation"
)

@Composable
fun ReorderableCollectionItemScope.reorderableDragHandle(): Modifier {
    val hapticFeedback = LocalHapticFeedback.current
    return Modifier.longPressDraggableHandle(
        onDragStarted = {
            // Platform haptics honor the user's touch-feedback setting.
            hapticFeedback.performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackType.GestureThresholdActivate)
        }
    )
}

@Composable
fun ReorderableListItem(
    scope: ReorderableCollectionItemScope,
    isDragging: Boolean,
    content: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit
) {
    val elevation by reorderableElevation(isDragging)
    Surface(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        shadowElevation = elevation
    ) {
        Row(
            modifier = Modifier
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .then(with(scope) { reorderableDragHandle() }),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
            content = content
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun ReorderableGridItem(
    scope: ReorderableCollectionItemScope,
    isDragging: Boolean,
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val elevation by reorderableElevation(isDragging)
    Surface(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(with(scope) { reorderableDragHandle() }),
        shadowElevation = elevation
    ) {
        content()
    }
}

@Composable
fun ConfirmDialog(
    title: String? = null,
    message: String,
    confirmText: String = stringResource(R.string.action_ok),
    dismissText: String? = stringResource(R.string.action_cancel),
    confirmIcon: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null,
    messageTextAlign: TextAlign = TextAlign.Start,
    onConfirm: () -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit
) {
    val confirmFocusRequester = remember { FocusRequester() }
    val dismissFocusRequester = remember { FocusRequester() }

    LaunchedEffect(dismissText) {
        if (dismissText != null) dismissFocusRequester.requestFocus()
        else confirmFocusRequester.requestFocus()
    }

    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        title = title?.let { { Text(it) } },
        text = {
            Text(
                text = message,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                textAlign = messageTextAlign
            )
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(
                onClick = { onConfirm(); onDismiss() },
                modifier = Modifier.focusRequester(confirmFocusRequester)
            ) {
                confirmIcon?.invoke()
                if (confirmIcon != null) Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                Text(confirmText)
            }
        },
        dismissButton = dismissText?.let { text ->
            {
                TextButton(
                    onClick = onDismiss,
                    modifier = Modifier.focusRequester(dismissFocusRequester)
                ) {
                    Text(text)
                }
            }
        },
        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
    )
}

@Composable
fun InputDialog(
    title: String,
    fields: List<InputField>,
    onFieldChange: (Int, String) -> Unit,

                                backgroundColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
                            )
                        ),
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()
                    )
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = onConfirm) { Text(confirmText) }
        },

/**
 * When showRadio is true, displays RadioButton (single selection mode);
 * otherwise, plain clickable list mode.
 * The selectedOption parameter is used to highlight the selected item only when showRadio is true.
 */
@Composable
fun <T> SelectListDialog(
    options: List<T>,
    optionText: @Composable (T) -> String,
    onSelected: (T) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    title: String? = null,
    selectedOption: T? = null,
    showRadio: Boolean = false
) {
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        title = title?.let { { Text(it) } },
        text = {
            LazyColumn {
                items(options) { option ->
                    val isSelected = option == selectedOption
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier
                            .fillMaxWidth()
                            .then(
                                if (showRadio) Modifier.selectable(
                                    selected = isSelected,
                                    onClick = { onSelected(option) },
                                    role = Role.RadioButton
                                ) else Modifier.clickable { onSelected(option) }
                            )
                            .padding(vertical = 12.dp, horizontal = 4.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        if (showRadio) {
                            RadioButton(
                                selected = isSelected,
                                onClick = null
                            )
                            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        }
                        Text(
                            text = optionText(option),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {},
        dismissButton = {
            TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.action_cancel))
            }
        },
        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
    )
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
fun FormDropdownField(
    label: String,
    value: String,
    options: List<String>,
    onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    editable: Boolean = false,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    placeholder: String? = null,
    supportingText: String? = null,
) {
    var expanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val menuScrollState = rememberScrollState()
    val focusManager = LocalFocusManager.current
    val keyboardController = LocalSoftwareKeyboardController.current

    ExposedDropdownMenuBox(
        expanded = expanded,
        onExpandedChange = { newExpanded ->
            if (!enabled) return@ExposedDropdownMenuBox
            if (!editable && newExpanded) {
                keyboardController?.hide()
            }
            expanded = newExpanded
        },
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp)
    ) {
        OutlinedTextField(
            value = value,
            onValueChange = { if (editable) onValueChange(it) },
            readOnly = !editable,
            enabled = enabled,
            label = { Text(label) },
            placeholder = { if (placeholder != null) Text(placeholder) },
            supportingText = supportingText?.let { { Text(it) } },
            trailingIcon = { ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults.TrailingIcon(expanded = expanded) },
            colors = OutlinedTextFieldDefaults.colors(
                focusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                unfocusedContainerColor = Color.Transparent,
                cursorColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
                selectionColors = TextSelectionColors(
                    handleColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary,
                    backgroundColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary.copy(alpha = 0.4f)
                )
            ),
            modifier = Modifier
                .menuAnchor(
                    type = if (editable) ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType.PrimaryEditable
                    else ExposedDropdownMenuAnchorType.PrimaryNotEditable
                )
                .fillMaxWidth()
                .onFocusChanged { focusState ->
                    if (!editable && focusState.isFocused) {
                        keyboardController?.hide()
                    }
                }
        )
        ExposedDropdownMenu(
            expanded = expanded,
            onDismissRequest = { expanded = false },
            modifier = Modifier.verticalScrollbar(menuScrollState),
            scrollState = menuScrollState,
            containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface
        ) {
            options.forEach { option ->
                DropdownMenuItem(
                    text = { Text(option) },
                    onClick = {
                        onValueChange(option)
                        expanded = false
                        focusManager.clearFocus()
                    }
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.compose

import androidx.compose.animation.core.Animatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.foundation.ScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyListState
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.grid.LazyGridState
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import androidx.compose.runtime.State
import androidx.compose.runtime.derivedStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.snapshotFlow
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.composed
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithContent
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.CornerRadius
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.drawscope.DrawScope
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.Dp
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.LayoutDirection
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.currentStateAsState
import com.v2ray.ang.extension.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collectLatest

data class ScrollbarConfig(
    val thickness: Dp = 4.dp,
    val minThumbSize: Dp = 24.dp,
    val thumbColor: Color = Color.Unspecified,
    val trackColor: Color = Color.Transparent,
    val padding: Dp = 2.dp,
    val cornerRadius: Dp = 2.dp,
    val fadeOutDurationMs: Int = 1500,
    val fadeAnimDurationMs: Int = 300,
)

private data class ScrollbarThumb(val offset: Float, val length: Float, val trackLength: Float)

@Composable
private fun <T> rememberScrollbarAlpha(
    key: Any,
    config: ScrollbarConfig,
    position: () -> T,
): State<Float> {
    val alpha = remember(key) { Animatable(0f) }
    val lifecycleState = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle.currentStateAsState()
    LaunchedEffect(key, config.fadeOutDurationMs, config.fadeAnimDurationMs) {
        snapshotFlow(position).collectLatest {
            alpha.snapTo(1f)
            delay(config.fadeOutDurationMs.toLong())
            alpha.animateTo(0f, tween(config.fadeAnimDurationMs))
        }
    }
    return remember(alpha, lifecycleState) {
        derivedStateOf {
            if (lifecycleState.value == Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) alpha.value else 0f
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun scrollbarThumbColor(config: ScrollbarConfig): Color =
    if (config.thumbColor == Color.Unspecified) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.secondary.copy(alpha = 0.7f)
    else config.thumbColor

private fun calculateThumb(
    viewport: Float,
    contentLength: Float,
    scrolled: Float,
    minLength: Float,
): ScrollbarThumb? {
    if (viewport <= 0f || contentLength <= viewport) return null
    val length = (viewport * viewport / contentLength).coerceAtLeast(minLength).coerceAtMost(viewport * 0.5f)
    val offset = (scrolled / (contentLength - viewport)).coerceIn(0f, 1f) * (viewport - length)
    return ScrollbarThumb(offset, length, viewport)
}

private fun DrawScope.drawVerticalScrollbar(
    thumb: ScrollbarThumb,
    alpha: Float,
    config: ScrollbarConfig,
    thumbColor: Color,
) {
    val thickness = config.thickness.toPx()
    val padding = config.padding.toPx()
    val radius = CornerRadius(config.cornerRadius.toPx())
    val x = if (layoutDirection == LayoutDirection.Rtl) padding else size.width - thickness - padding
    if (config.trackColor != Color.Transparent) {
        drawRoundRect(
            config.trackColor.copy(alpha = config.trackColor.alpha * alpha),
            Offset(x, 0f),
            Size(thickness, thumb.trackLength),
            radius
        )
    }
    drawRoundRect(
        thumbColor.copy(alpha = thumbColor.alpha * alpha),
        Offset(x, thumb.offset),
        Size(thickness, thumb.length),
        radius
    )
}

private fun DrawScope.drawHorizontalScrollbar(
    thumb: ScrollbarThumb,
    alpha: Float,
    config: ScrollbarConfig,
    thumbColor: Color,
) {
    val thickness = config.thickness.toPx()
    val y = size.height - thickness - config.padding.toPx()
    val radius = CornerRadius(config.cornerRadius.toPx())
    if (config.trackColor != Color.Transparent) {
        drawRoundRect(
            config.trackColor.copy(alpha = config.trackColor.alpha * alpha),
            Offset(0f, y),
            Size(thumb.trackLength, thickness),
            radius
        )
    }
    drawRoundRect(
        thumbColor.copy(alpha = thumbColor.alpha * alpha),
        Offset(thumb.offset, y),
        Size(thumb.length, thickness),
        radius
    )
}

fun Modifier.verticalScrollbar(scrollState: ScrollState, config: ScrollbarConfig = ScrollbarConfig()): Modifier = composed {
    val alpha = rememberScrollbarAlpha(scrollState, config) { scrollState.value }
    val thumbColor = scrollbarThumbColor(config)
    drawWithContent {
        drawContent()
        if (alpha.value <= 0f) return@drawWithContent
        val viewport = size.height
        val contentLength = viewport + scrollState.maxValue
        val thumb = calculateThumb(viewport, contentLength, scrollState.value.toFloat(), config.minThumbSize.toPx())
            ?: return@drawWithContent
        drawVerticalScrollbar(thumb, alpha.value, config, thumbColor)
    }
}

fun Modifier.horizontalScrollbar(scrollState: ScrollState, config: ScrollbarConfig = ScrollbarConfig()): Modifier = composed {
    val alpha = rememberScrollbarAlpha(scrollState, config) { scrollState.value }
    val thumbColor = scrollbarThumbColor(config)
    drawWithContent {
        drawContent()
        if (alpha.value <= 0f) return@drawWithContent
        val viewport = size.width
        val contentLength = viewport + scrollState.maxValue
        val thumb = calculateThumb(viewport, contentLength, scrollState.value.toFloat(), config.minThumbSize.toPx())
            ?: return@drawWithContent
        drawHorizontalScrollbar(thumb, alpha.value, config, thumbColor)
    }
}

fun Modifier.verticalScrollbar(lazyListState: LazyListState, config: ScrollbarConfig = ScrollbarConfig()): Modifier = composed {
    val alpha = rememberScrollbarAlpha(lazyListState, config) {
        lazyListState.firstVisibleItemIndex to lazyListState.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset
    }
    val thumbColor = scrollbarThumbColor(config)
    drawWithContent {
        drawContent()
        val layout = lazyListState.layoutInfo
        val visible = layout.visibleItemsInfo
        if (alpha.value <= 0f || visible.isEmpty()) return@drawWithContent
        val viewport = layout.viewportSize.height.toFloat()
        val averageItemHeight = visible.sumOf { it.size } / visible.size.toFloat()
        val scrolled = visible.first().index * averageItemHeight + layout.viewportStartOffset - visible.first().offset
        val contentLength = averageItemHeight * layout.totalItemsCount
        val thumb = calculateThumb(viewport, contentLength, scrolled, config.minThumbSize.toPx())
            ?: return@drawWithContent
        drawVerticalScrollbar(thumb, alpha.value, config, thumbColor)
    }
}

fun Modifier.verticalScrollbar(lazyGridState: LazyGridState, config: ScrollbarConfig = ScrollbarConfig()): Modifier = composed {
    val alpha = rememberScrollbarAlpha(lazyGridState, config) {
        lazyGridState.firstVisibleItemIndex to lazyGridState.firstVisibleItemScrollOffset
    }
    val thumbColor = scrollbarThumbColor(config)
    drawWithContent {
        drawContent()
        val layout = lazyGridState.layoutInfo
        val visible = layout.visibleItemsInfo
        if (alpha.value <= 0f || visible.isEmpty()) return@drawWithContent
        val rows = visible.groupBy { it.row }
        val averageRowHeight = rows.values.map { row -> row.maxOf { it.size.height } }.average().toFloat()
        val columns = rows.values.first().size
        val totalRows = (layout.totalItemsCount + columns - 1) / columns
        val first = visible.first()
        val scrolled = first.row * averageRowHeight + layout.viewportStartOffset - first.offset.y
        val viewport = layout.viewportSize.height.toFloat()
        val contentLength = averageRowHeight * totalRows
        val thumb = calculateThumb(viewport, contentLength, scrolled, config.minThumbSize.toPx())
            ?: return@drawWithContent
        drawVerticalScrollbar(thumb, alpha.value, config, thumbColor)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SettingsItemRow(
    icon: Painter?,
    title: String,
    description: String?,
    enabled: Boolean,
    onClick: (() -> Unit)?,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    trailing: @Composable (() -> Unit)? = null
) {
    val titleColor = if (enabled) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface
    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface.copy(alpha = 0.38f)
    val descriptionColor = if (enabled) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
    else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant.copy(alpha = 0.38f)

    Row(
        modifier = modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .then(if (onClick != null) Modifier.clickable(enabled = enabled, onClick = onClick) else Modifier)
            .padding(16.dp),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
    ) {
        if (icon != null) {
            Icon(
                painter = icon,
                contentDescription = null,
                modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp),
                tint = titleColor
            )
            Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
        }
        Column(modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(
                text = title,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge,
                color = titleColor
            )
            if (!description.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(4.dp))
                Text(
                    text = description,
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = descriptionColor
                )
            }
        }
        trailing?.invoke()
    }
}

@Composable
fun SettingsEditItem(
    icon: Painter? = null,
    title: String,
    value: String,
    onValueChanged: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    isPassword: Boolean = false,
    keyboardNumber: Boolean = false
) {
    var showDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val description = if (isPassword) {
        if (value.isEmpty()) null else "******"
    } else {
        value.ifEmpty { null }
    }

    SettingsItemRow(
        icon = icon,
        title = title,
        description = description,
        enabled = enabled,
        onClick = if (enabled) {
            { showDialog = true }
        } else null,
        modifier = modifier
    )

    if (showDialog) {
        var text by remember { mutableStateOf(value) }
        InputDialog(
            title = title,
            fields = listOf(
                InputField(
                    label = title,
                    value = text,
                    visualTransformation = VisualTransformation.None
                )
            ),
            onFieldChange = { _, v -> text = v },
            confirmText = stringResource(R.string.action_ok),
            dismissText = stringResource(R.string.action_cancel),
            onConfirm = { showDialog = false; onValueChanged(text) },
            onDismiss = { showDialog = false }
        )
    }
}

@Composable
fun SettingsListItem(
    icon: Painter? = null,
    title: String,
    entries: List<String>,
    values: List<String>,
    selectedValue: String,
    onSelected: (String) -> Unit,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enabled: Boolean = true
) {
    var showDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val options = entries.zip(values)
    val selectedOption = options.find { it.second == selectedValue } ?: options.firstOrNull()
    val summary = selectedOption?.first.orEmpty()

    SettingsItemRow(
        icon = icon,
        title = title,
        description = summary.ifEmpty { null },
        enabled = enabled,
        onClick = if (enabled) {
            { showDialog = true }
        } else null,
        modifier = modifier
    )

    if (showDialog) {
        SelectListDialog(
            title = title,
            options = options,
            optionText = { it.first },
            selectedOption = selectedOption,
            onSelected = { option ->
                showDialog = false
                onSelected(option.second)
            },
            onDismiss = { showDialog = false },
            showRadio = true
        )
    }
}

}

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asSharedFlow

enum class ToastType {
    NORMAL, SUCCESS, ERROR, INFO
}

data class AppSnackbarMessage(
    val message: CharSequence,
    val type: ToastType = ToastType.NORMAL,
    val long: Boolean = false,
)

object AppSnackbarManager {
    private val _messages = MutableSharedFlow<AppSnackbarMessage>(
        replay = 0,
        extraBufferCapacity = 32,
        onBufferOverflow = BufferOverflow.DROP_OLDEST
    )
    val messages = _messages.asSharedFlow()

    fun hasActiveHost(): Boolean = _messages.subscriptionCount.value > 0

    fun show(
        message: CharSequence,
        type: ToastType = ToastType.NORMAL,
        long: Boolean = false,
    ): Boolean {
        if (!hasActiveHost()) return false
        return _messages.tryEmit(
            AppSnackbarMessage(
                message = message,
                type = type,
                long = long
            )
        )
    }
}

class AppSnackbarController(
    val hostState: SnackbarHostState,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
) {
    private var currentId = 0
    private var currentShowTime = 0L

    fun show(message: CharSequence, type: ToastType = ToastType.NORMAL, long: Boolean = false) {
        val id = ++currentId
        scope.launch {
            if (currentShowTime != 0L) {
                val elapsed = System.currentTimeMillis() - currentShowTime
                if (elapsed < SnackbarThrottleMs) {
                    delay((SnackbarThrottleMs - elapsed))
                }
            }

            hostState.currentSnackbarData?.dismiss()

            launch {
                hostState.showSnackbar(
                    AppSnackbarVisuals(
                        message = message.toString(),
                        type = type,
                        duration = if (long) SnackbarDuration.Long else SnackbarDuration.Short
                    )
                )
                if (id == currentId) {
                    currentShowTime = 0L
                }
            }

            currentShowTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
        }
    }
}

private data class AppSnackbarVisuals(
    override val message: String,
    val type: ToastType,
    override val duration: SnackbarDuration,
    override val actionLabel: String? = null,
    override val withDismissAction: Boolean = false
) : SnackbarVisuals

val LocalAppSnackbar = staticCompositionLocalOf<AppSnackbarController> {
    error("AppSnackbarController not provided. Wrap your content in AppTheme.")
}

@Composable
fun rememberAppSnackbarController(): AppSnackbarController {
    val hostState = remember { SnackbarHostState() }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    return remember(hostState, scope) { AppSnackbarController(hostState, scope) }
}

@Composable
fun AppSnackbarBridge(
    controller: AppSnackbarController
) {
    val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current

    LaunchedEffect(controller, lifecycleOwner) {
        lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) {
            AppSnackbarManager.messages.collect { event ->
                controller.show(
                    message = event.message,
                    type = event.type,
                    long = event.long
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

private val ToastCornerRadius = 24.dp
private val ToastHorizontalPad = 16.dp
private val ToastVerticalPad = 12.dp
private const val ToastMaxLines = 8
private const val ToastMaxWidthFraction = 0.75f
private val ToastBottomOffset = 100.dp
private const val SnackbarThrottleMs = 2000L

@Composable
fun AppSnackbarHost(
    hostState: SnackbarHostState,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier
) {
    BoxWithConstraints(modifier = modifier) {
        val maxSnackbarWidth = maxWidth * ToastMaxWidthFraction
        val density = LocalDensity.current
        val navigationBarHeight = with(density) {
            WindowInsets.navigationBars.getBottom(this).toDp()
        }

        SnackbarHost(
            hostState = hostState,
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()
        ) { data ->
            val type = (data.visuals as? AppSnackbarVisuals)?.type ?: ToastType.NORMAL

            val isDark = LocalDarkTheme.current
            val bgColor = when (type) {
                ToastType.NORMAL -> if (isDark) toastNormalBgDark else toastNormalBgLight
                ToastType.SUCCESS -> toastSuccessBg
                ToastType.ERROR -> toastErrorBg
                ToastType.INFO -> toastInfoBg
            }

            Box(
                modifier = Modifier
                    .fillMaxSize()
                    .padding(bottom = ToastBottomOffset + navigationBarHeight),
                contentAlignment = Alignment.BottomCenter
            ) {
                Surface(
                    modifier = Modifier
                        .wrapContentWidth()
                        .widthIn(max = maxSnackbarWidth),
                    shape = RoundedCornerShape(ToastCornerRadius),
                    color = bgColor,
                    shadowElevation = 0.dp,
                ) {
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.padding(
                            horizontal = ToastHorizontalPad,
                            vertical = ToastVerticalPad
                        ),
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.Center,
                        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
                    ) {
                        Text(
                            text = data.visuals.message,
                            color = toastTextColor,
                            fontSize = 14.sp,
                            maxLines = ToastMaxLines,
                            overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
                            modifier = Modifier.wrapContentWidth()
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/** The single colour palette of the neon "spatial" look. The theme, the home screen and the shared components read from here. */
object SpatialPalette {
    val SkyTop = Color(0xFF0A0F2E)
    val SkyIndigo = Color(0xFF1B1766)
    val SkyPurple = Color(0xFF4B1A73)
    val SkyMagenta = Color(0xFFB3235E)
    val Cyan = Color(0xFF22D3EE)
    val Magenta = Color(0xFFE879F9)
    val Purple = Color(0xFF9B5DE5)
    val Emerald = Color(0xFF34D399)
    val Amber = Color(0xFFFACC15)
    val Pink = Color(0xFFF472B6)
    val Rose = Color(0xFFF43F5E)
    val OceanBlue = Color(0xFF6C7DFF)
    val TextSoft = Color(0xB3FFFFFF)
    val DrawerSurface = Color(0xF20B1124)
}

private val SkyTop = SpatialPalette.SkyTop
private val SkyIndigo = SpatialPalette.SkyIndigo
private val SkyPurple = SpatialPalette.SkyPurple
private val SkyMagenta = SpatialPalette.SkyMagenta
private val Cyan = SpatialPalette.Cyan
private val Magenta = SpatialPalette.Magenta
private val Emerald = SpatialPalette.Emerald
private val Pink = SpatialPalette.Pink

private const val STAR_COUNT = 90

// Shared building blocks of the spatial look: used by the home screen and available to every other screen.

@Composable
fun SpatialBackground() {
    val stars = remember {
        val random = Random(7)
        List(STAR_COUNT) {
            floatArrayOf(random.nextFloat(), random.nextFloat(), 0.6f + random.nextFloat() * 1.6f, 0.25f + random.nextFloat() * 0.6f)
        }
    }
    Canvas(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        drawRect(Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(SkyTop, SkyIndigo, SkyPurple, SkyMagenta)))
        drawCircle(
            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                listOf(Cyan.copy(alpha = 0.16f), Color.Transparent),
                center = Offset(size.width * 0.15f, size.height * 0.2f),
                radius = size.width * 0.8f,
            ),
            radius = size.width * 0.8f,
            center = Offset(size.width * 0.15f, size.height * 0.2f),
        )
        drawCircle(
            brush = Brush.radialGradient(
                listOf(Magenta.copy(alpha = 0.18f), Color.Transparent),
                center = Offset(size.width * 0.9f, size.height * 0.95f),
                radius = size.width * 0.9f,
            ),
            radius = size.width * 0.9f,
            center = Offset(size.width * 0.9f, size.height * 0.95f),
        )
        stars.forEach { s ->
            drawCircle(Color.White.copy(alpha = s[3]), radius = s[2], center = Offset(s[0] * size.width, s[1] * size.height))
        }
    }
}

    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    onClick: (() -> Unit)? = null,
    content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit,
) {
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(26.dp)
    Column(
        modifier = modifier
            .clip(shape)
            .background(Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.20f), Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.07f))))
            .border(
                1.dp,
                Brush.linearGradient(listOf(Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.45f), Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.10f))),
                shape,
            )
            .let { if (onClick != null) it.clickable(onClick = onClick) else it }
            .padding(18.dp),
        content = content,
    )
}

@Composable
fun GradientButton(label: String, running: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    val colors = if (running) {
        listOf(Color(0xFF2DD4BF), Color(0xFF8B5CF6), Color(0xFFF87171))
    } else {
        listOf(Color(0xFF22D3EE), Color(0xFF6366F1), Color(0xFFEC4899))
    }
    val shape = RoundedCornerShape(18.dp)
    Box(
        modifier = Modifier
            .fillMaxWidth()
            .height(56.dp)
            .clip(shape)
            .background(Brush.horizontalGradient(colors))
            .border(1.dp, Color.White.copy(alpha = 0.35f), shape)
            .clickable(role = Role.Button, onClick = onClick),
        contentAlignment = Alignment.Center,
    ) {
        Text(label, color = Color.White, fontSize = 18.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold)
    }
}

    ) {

    }
}

@Composable
fun GlassChip(
    label: String,
    accent: Color,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    enabled: Boolean = true,
    onClick: () -> Unit,
) {

            Text(label, color = tint, fontSize = 13.sp, fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold, maxLines = 1)
        }
    }
}

/** Live line chart of the proxy download speed (pink to cyan), with a soft fill. */
@Composable
fun NeonSparkline(values: List<Long>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Canvas(modifier = modifier) {
        val points = if (values.size >= 2) values else listOf(0L, 0L)
        val max = (points.maxOrNull() ?: 1L).coerceAtLeast(1L).toFloat()
        val step = size.width / (points.size - 1)
        val line = Path()
        val fill = Path()
        points.forEachIndexed { i, v ->
            val x = i * step
            val y = size.height * (1f - (v.toFloat() / max).coerceIn(0.06f, 0.96f))
            if (i == 0) {
                line.moveTo(x, y)
                fill.moveTo(x, size.height)
                fill.lineTo(x, y)
            } else {
                line.lineTo(x, y)
                fill.lineTo(x, y)
            }
        }
        fill.lineTo(size.width, size.height)
        fill.close()
        val brush = Brush.horizontalGradient(listOf(Pink, Magenta, Cyan, Emerald))
        drawPath(fill, Brush.verticalGradient(listOf(Cyan.copy(alpha = 0.25f), Color.Transparent)))
        drawPath(line, brush, style = Stroke(width = 4f, cap = StrokeCap.Round))
    }
}

object ThemeManager {
    private val _themeMode = MutableStateFlow(
        MmkvManager.decodeSettingsString(AppConfig.PREF_UI_MODE_NIGHT, "0") ?: "0"
    )
    val themeMode: StateFlow<String> = _themeMode.asStateFlow()

    private val _dynamicColorEnabled = MutableStateFlow(
        MmkvManager.decodeSettingsBool(AppConfig.PREF_DYNAMIC_COLOR, true)
    )
    val dynamicColorEnabled: StateFlow<Boolean> = _dynamicColorEnabled.asStateFlow()

    /** "" = not chosen yet (treated as on), "1" = on, "0" = off (classic light/dark/dynamic themes). */
    private val _spatialThemeMode = MutableStateFlow(
        MmkvManager.decodeSettingsString(AppConfig.PREF_SPATIAL_THEME, "").orEmpty()
    )
    val spatialThemeMode: StateFlow<String> = _spatialThemeMode.asStateFlow()

    fun setSpatialThemeEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        val mode = if (enabled) "1" else "0"
        MmkvManager.encodeSettings(AppConfig.PREF_SPATIAL_THEME, mode)
        _spatialThemeMode.value = mode
    }

    fun setThemeMode(mode: String) {
        MmkvManager.encodeSettings(AppConfig.PREF_UI_MODE_NIGHT, mode)
        _themeMode.value = mode
    }

    fun setDynamicColorEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        MmkvManager.encodeSettings(AppConfig.PREF_DYNAMIC_COLOR, enabled)
        _dynamicColorEnabled.value = enabled
    }

    fun refresh() {
        _themeMode.value =
            MmkvManager.decodeSettingsString(AppConfig.PREF_UI_MODE_NIGHT, "0") ?: "0"
        _dynamicColorEnabled.value =
            MmkvManager.decodeSettingsBool(AppConfig.PREF_DYNAMIC_COLOR, true)
        _spatialThemeMode.value =
            MmkvManager.decodeSettingsString(AppConfig.PREF_SPATIAL_THEME, "").orEmpty()
    }
}

@Composable
fun resolveDarkTheme(): Boolean {
    val mode by ThemeManager.themeMode.collectAsState()
    return when (mode) {
        "1" -> false
        "2" -> true
        else -> isSystemInDarkTheme()
    }
}

val LocalDarkTheme = compositionLocalOf { false }

/** True while the neon spatial theme is active (list rows then render as Bento cards). */
val LocalSpatialTheme = compositionLocalOf { false }

@Composable
fun AppTheme(
    systemDarkTheme: Boolean = resolveDarkTheme(),
    content: @Composable () -> Unit
) {
    val dynamicColor by ThemeManager.dynamicColorEnabled.collectAsState()
    // Older installations may have saved the removed classic theme; always use spatial here.
    val spatialTheme = true
    // The neon scheme is always dark, so every dark-dependent component must see darkTheme = true.
    val darkTheme = systemDarkTheme || spatialTheme
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val colorScheme = when {
        spatialTheme -> SpatialColor
        dynamicColor && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S -> {
            if (darkTheme) dynamicDarkColorScheme(context) else dynamicLightColorScheme(context)
        }

        darkTheme -> DarkColor
        else -> LightColor
    }
    val snackbarController = rememberAppSnackbarController()

    val view = LocalView.current
    if (!view.isInEditMode) {
        SideEffect {
            val activity = view.context as? Activity ?: return@SideEffect
            val window = activity.window
            WindowCompat.getInsetsController(window, view).apply {
                isAppearanceLightStatusBars = !darkTheme
                isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = !darkTheme
            }
        }
    }

    CompositionLocalProvider(
        LocalDarkTheme provides darkTheme,
        LocalSpatialTheme provides spatialTheme,
        LocalAppSnackbar provides snackbarController
    ) {
        MaterialTheme(
            colorScheme = colorScheme
        ) {
            Box(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                AppSnackbarBridge(controller = snackbarController)
                content()
                AppSnackbarHost(hostState = snackbarController.hostState)
            }
        }
    }
}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import com.v2ray.ang.AppConfig
import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ProfileItem
import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ServersCache
import com.v2ray.ang.enums.EConfigType
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class BatchDeletionPlanTest {
    private fun row(guid: String, group: String = "g", host: String = "host", delay: Long = 0L,
                    type: EConfigType = EConfigType.VLESS) =
        ServersCache(guid, ProfileItem(configType = type, subscriptionId = group, server = host, remarks = guid), delay)

    @Test
    fun freezesExactVisibleTargetsForEachKind() {
        val rows = listOf(row("first", delay = 1), row("duplicate", delay = -1),
            row("other", host = "other", delay = -3), row("untested"), row("custom", type = EConfigType.CUSTOM))
        assertEquals(rows.map { it.guid }, BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, rows)!!.targetGuids)
        assertEquals(listOf("duplicate", "untested"), BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.DUPLICATES, null, rows)!!.targetGuids)
        assertEquals(listOf("duplicate", "other"), BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.INVALID, null, rows)!!.targetGuids)
        assertTrue(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, emptyList())!!.targetGuids.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsAmbiguousIdsAndWrongGroupsButAcceptsDefaultAndAllGroups() {
        assertNull(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, listOf(row(""))))
        assertNull(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, listOf(row("a"), row("a"))))
        assertNull(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, listOf(row("a", "other"))))
        assertNotNull(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible(AppConfig.DEFAULT_SUBSCRIPTION_ID, BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, listOf(row("a", ""))))
        assertNotNull(BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("", BatchDeletionKind.VISIBLE, null, listOf(row("a", "g"), row("b", "other"))))
    }

    @Test
    fun detectsChangesToTargetsDuplicateKeepersSelectionAndGroup() {
        val rows = listOf(row("a"), row("b"))
        val plan = BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.DUPLICATES, "a", rows)!!
        val profiles = rows.associate { it.guid to it.profile.copy() }.toMutableMap()
        val members = profiles.keys.toSet()
        fun valid(groupExists: Boolean = true, selected: String? = "a", present: Set<String> = members) =
            plan.isStillValid(groupExists, selected, present, profiles::get) { 0 }
        assertTrue(valid())
        assertFalse(valid(groupExists = false))
        assertFalse(valid(selected = "b"))
        assertFalse(valid(present = setOf("b"))) // The keeper disappeared.
        assertFalse(valid(present = setOf("a"))) // The target disappeared.
        profiles["a"] = profiles.getValue("a").copy(server = "different")
        assertFalse(valid())
    }

    @Test
    fun copiesMutableProfilesAndRejectsNewResultsForInvalidDeletion() {
        val row = row("a", delay = -1)
        val plan = BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.INVALID, null, listOf(row))!!
        val original = row.profile.copy()
        fun valid(profile: ProfileItem?, delay: Long?) = plan.isStillValid(true, null, setOf("a"), { profile }, { delay })
        assertTrue(valid(original, -1L))
        assertFalse(valid(original, 1L))
        assertFalse(valid(original, null))
        assertFalse(valid(null, -1L))
        row.profile.remarks = "edited"
        assertFalse(valid(row.profile, -1L))
        assertTrue(valid(original, -1L))
        val empty = BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.INVALID, null, emptyList())!!
        assertFalse(empty.isStillValid(true, null, emptySet(), { null }, { null }))
    }
    @Test
    fun targetsCannotBeMutatedAndReadFailuresDoNotBecomeApproval() {
        val row = row("a", delay = -1)
        val plan = BatchDeletionPlan.fromVisible("g", BatchDeletionKind.INVALID, null, listOf(row))!!
        assertThrows(UnsupportedOperationException::class.java) {
            (plan.targetGuids as MutableList<String>).clear()
        }
        assertEquals(listOf("a"), plan.targetGuids)
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            plan.isStillValid(true, null, setOf("a"), { throw IllegalStateException("read failure") }, { -1L })
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            plan.isStillValid(true, null, setOf("a"), { row.profile }, { throw IllegalStateException("read failure") })
        }
    }
}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import com.v2ray.ang.dto.ConnectionTestResult
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class ConnectionSelectionTest {
    @Test
    fun changingSelectionDropsOldConnectionResultButKeepsBulkProgress() {
        val previous = MainUiState(
            selectedGuid = "a", isRunning = true, isTesting = true,
            status = MainStatus.TestProgress("4/10"),
            connectionStatus = MainStatus.ConnectionTest(ConnectionTestResult(180, country = "US")),
            selectedInfo = SelectedServerInfo("old", 180),
        )
        assertSame(previous, stateAfterSelectionChange(previous, "a", true))
        val next = stateAfterSelectionChange(previous, "b", true)
        assertEquals("b", next.selectedGuid)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Connected, next.connectionStatus)
        assertEquals(previous.status, next.status)
        assertTrue(next.isTesting)
        assertNull(next.selectedInfo)
        val bulkWithoutProgress = stateAfterSelectionChange(previous.copy(status = previous.connectionStatus), "b", true)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Testing, bulkWithoutProgress.status)
    }

    @Test
    fun selectionChangeClearsCurrentTestWithoutInventingRunningState() {
        val requests = MainTestRequests()
        val request = requests.beginCurrent()
        requests.invalidateCurrent()
        assertFalse(requests.completeCurrent(request))
        val running = MainUiState(selectedGuid = "a", isRunning = true, isTesting = true,
            status = MainStatus.Testing, connectionStatus = MainStatus.Testing)
        val switched = stateAfterSelectionChange(running, "b", requests.bulk != null)
        assertFalse(switched.isTesting)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Connected, switched.status)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Connected, switched.connectionStatus)
        val stopped = stateAfterSelectionChange(running.copy(isRunning = false), null, false)
        assertNull(stopped.selectedGuid)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Disconnected, stopped.status)
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Disconnected, stopped.connectionStatus)
    }
}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ProfileItem
import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ServersCache
import com.v2ray.ang.enums.EConfigType
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class DisplaySortTest {
    private fun server(id: String, name: String, delay: Long) =
        ServersCache(id, ProfileItem(configType = EConfigType.VMESS, remarks = name), delay)

    private fun row(server: ServersCache) = ServerRowUiModel(
        guid = server.guid, profile = server.profile, remarks = server.profile.remarks,
        statistics = "", typeDescription = "", testDelayMillis = server.testDelayMillis,
        testTime = 0L, subscriptionBadge = "",
    )

    @Test
    fun defaultKeepsOriginalListsAndNeverMutatesThem() {
        val servers = listOf(server("1", "Zulu", 0), server("2", "alpha", 100))
        val rows = servers.map(::row)
        val result = sortVisibleServerRows(servers, rows, ServerDisplaySort.DEFAULT)
        assertSame(servers, result.first)
        assertSame(rows, result.second)
        assertEquals(listOf("1", "2"), servers.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(emptyList<ServersCache>(), sortVisibleServerRows(emptyList(), emptyList(), ServerDisplaySort.PING).first)
    }

    @Test
    fun pingSortShowsPositiveDelaysFirstAndKeepsTiesStable() {
        val servers = listOf(server("u", "u", 0), server("x", "x", -1), server("slow", "s", 200),
            server("a", "a", 100), server("b", "b", 100))
        val rows = servers.map(::row)
        val (sorted, sortedRows) = sortVisibleServerRows(servers, rows, ServerDisplaySort.PING)
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b", "slow", "u", "x"), sorted.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(sorted.map { it.guid }, sortedRows.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(listOf("u", "x", "slow", "a", "b"), servers.map { it.guid })
    }

    @Test
    fun nameSortIsCaseInsensitiveAndKeepsTiesInStoredOrder() {
        val servers = listOf(server("1", "Zulu", 0), server("2", "alpha", -1),
            server("3", "Alpha", 9))
        assertEquals(listOf("2", "3", "1"), sortVisibleServerRows(servers, servers.map(::row), ServerDisplaySort.NAME).first.map { it.guid })
    }

    @Test
    fun mismatchedPairsAreRejected() {
        val a = server("a", "A", 100)
        val b = server("b", "B", 100)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { sortVisibleServerRows(listOf(a), emptyList(), ServerDisplaySort.DEFAULT) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { sortVisibleServerRows(listOf(a), listOf(row(b)), ServerDisplaySort.PING) }
    }

    @Test
    fun liveResultsReorderVisiblePingWithoutChangingKeywordOrder() {
        val servers = listOf(server("a", "A", 100), server("b", "B", 0))
        val state = ServerGroupUiState(
            servers = servers, rows = servers.map(::row), keywordServers = servers,
            keywordRows = servers.map(::row), totalCount = 2, appliedSort = ServerDisplaySort.PING,
            counts = countServerStatuses(servers, 250), topMaxMillis = 250,
        )
        val updated = applyLiveServerResults(state, mapOf("b" to 50), 1000)
        assertEquals(listOf("b", "a"), updated.rows.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b"), updated.keywordRows.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(FilterCounts(all = 2, top = 2, alive = 2), updated.counts)
    }
}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ProfileItem
import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.ServersCache
import com.v2ray.ang.enums.EConfigType
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertSame
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class LiveServerFilterTest {
    private fun server(id: String, delay: Long) =
        ServersCache(id, ProfileItem(configType = EConfigType.VMESS, remarks = id), delay, 1L)

    private fun row(server: ServersCache) = ServerRowUiModel(
        guid = server.guid, profile = server.profile, remarks = server.profile.remarks,
        statistics = "", typeDescription = "", testDelayMillis = server.testDelayMillis,
        testTime = server.testTime, subscriptionBadge = "",
    )

    private fun state(servers: List<ServersCache>, filter: ServerStatusFilter): ServerGroupUiState {
        val rows = servers.map(::row)
        val visibleIndices = servers.indices.filter { matchesServerStatus(servers[it].testDelayMillis, filter, 250) }
        return ServerGroupUiState(
            servers = visibleIndices.map { servers[it] }, rows = visibleIndices.map { rows[it] },
            keywordServers = servers, keywordRows = rows, totalCount = servers.size,
            appliedFilter = filter, topMaxMillis = 250, counts = countServerStatuses(servers, 250),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyAndUnknownUpdatesLeaveCountsAndRowsUnchanged() {
        val empty = state(emptyList(), ServerStatusFilter.UNTESTED)
        assertEquals(FilterCounts(), empty.counts)
        assertSame(empty, applyLiveServerResults(empty, mapOf("missing" to -1L), 10))
        val one = state(listOf(server("a", 0)), ServerStatusFilter.UNTESTED)
        assertSame(one, applyLiveServerResults(one, emptyMap(), 10))
        assertEquals(one, applyLiveServerResults(one, mapOf("missing" to 120L), 10))
    }

    @Test
    fun failedResultLeavesUntestedFilterAndUpdatesCounts() {
        val original = state(listOf(server("a", 0), server("b", 0)), ServerStatusFilter.UNTESTED)
        val updated = applyLiveServerResults(original, mapOf("a" to -1L), 100)
        assertEquals(listOf("b"), updated.rows.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(FilterCounts(all = 2, untested = 1, failed = 1), updated.counts)
        assertEquals(100L, updated.keywordRows.first().testTime)
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b"), updated.keywordServers.map { it.guid })
    }

    @Test
    fun previouslyHiddenServerEntersActiveFilterInOriginalOrder() {
        val original = state(listOf(server("a", 0), server("b", -1), server("c", -1)), ServerStatusFilter.ALIVE)
        val updated = applyLiveServerResults(original, mapOf("c" to 300L, "a" to 100L), 100)
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "c"), updated.rows.map { it.guid })
        assertEquals(FilterCounts(all = 3, top = 1, alive = 2, failed = 1), updated.counts)
        assertEquals(updated.counts, countServerStatuses(updated.keywordServers, 250))
    }

    @Test
    fun repeatedAndUnchangedResultsDoNotDoubleCount() {
        val original = state(listOf(server("a", 100), server("b", -1)), ServerStatusFilter.ALL)
        val once = applyLiveServerResults(original, mapOf("a" to 100L, "b" to 200L), 100)
        val twice = applyLiveServerResults(once, mapOf("b" to 200L), 200)
        assertEquals(FilterCounts(all = 2, top = 2, alive = 2), twice.counts)
        assertEquals(listOf("a", "b"), twice.rows.map { it.guid })
    }
}
END FILE: V2rayNG/app/src/test/java/com/v2ray/ang/ui/main/LiveServerFilterTest.kt

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class MainContractTest {

    @Test
    fun megabitsPerSecond_convertsBytesAndMillis() {
        // 5,000,000 bytes in 4 s = 10 Mbit/s
        assertEquals(10.0, megabitsPerSecond(5_000_000L, 4_000L), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun megabitsPerSecond_neverDividesByZero() {
        assertEquals(8_000.0, megabitsPerSecond(1_000_000L, 0L), 1e-9)
    }

    @Test
    fun initialUiState_hasNoRunOrSpeedTest() {
        val state = MainUiState()
        assertEquals(TestRunStats(), state.runStats)
        assertEquals(ServerDisplaySort.DEFAULT, state.displaySort)
        assertEquals(null, state.scopedTestProposal)
        assertEquals(0, state.resumableCount)
        assertEquals(SpeedTestState.Idle, state.speedTest)
    }
    @Test
    fun statusFiltersMatchTheDisplayedPing() {
        assertTrue(matchesServerStatus(-1, ServerStatusFilter.ALL, 250))
        assertTrue(matchesServerStatus(0, ServerStatusFilter.UNTESTED, 250))
        assertFalse(matchesServerStatus(0, ServerStatusFilter.ALIVE, 250))
        assertTrue(matchesServerStatus(-1, ServerStatusFilter.FAILED, 250))
        assertFalse(matchesServerStatus(1, ServerStatusFilter.FAILED, 250))
        assertTrue(matchesServerStatus(250, ServerStatusFilter.TOP, 250))
        assertFalse(matchesServerStatus(251, ServerStatusFilter.TOP, 250))
        assertTrue(matchesServerStatus(251, ServerStatusFilter.ALIVE, 250))
    }

    @Test
    fun filterScopeDistinguishesAllServersFromFilteredResults() {
        assertFalse(hasActiveServerFilter("", ServerStatusFilter.ALL))
        assertFalse(hasActiveServerFilter("  ", ServerStatusFilter.ALL))
        assertTrue(hasActiveServerFilter("server", ServerStatusFilter.ALL))
        assertTrue(hasActiveServerFilter("", ServerStatusFilter.FAILED))
    }

    @Test
    fun connectionStatusRemainsIndependentOfBulkTestReset() {
        val result = MainStatus.ConnectionTest(com.v2ray.ang.dto.ConnectionTestResult(100))
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Disconnected, MainUiState().connectionStatus)
        assertEquals(result, connectionStatusAfterTestReset(result, isRunning = true, currentPending = false))
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Testing, connectionStatusAfterTestReset(MainStatus.Testing, isRunning = true, currentPending = true))
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Connected, connectionStatusAfterTestReset(MainStatus.Testing, isRunning = true, currentPending = false))
        assertEquals(MainStatus.Disconnected, connectionStatusAfterTestReset(result, isRunning = false, currentPending = false))
    }

    @Test
    fun compactStatusOnlyUsesExplicitConnectionResults() {
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.NEEDS_TEST, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.Connected))
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.OTHER, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.Disconnected))
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.OTHER, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.Testing))
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.OTHER, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.ConnectionTest(com.v2ray.ang.dto.ConnectionTestResult(-1))))
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.SUCCESS, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.ConnectionTest(com.v2ray.ang.dto.ConnectionTestResult(25))))
        assertEquals(ConnectionSummaryKind.SUCCESS_WITH_COUNTRY, connectionSummaryKind(MainStatus.ConnectionTest(com.v2ray.ang.dto.ConnectionTestResult(25, country = "US"))))
    }

    @Test
    fun listControlsFollowVerticalScrollAndIgnoreJitterOrHorizontalPaging() {
        assertEquals(false, controlsExpandedAfterScroll(true, 0f, -10f))
        assertEquals(true, controlsExpandedAfterScroll(false, 0f, 10f))
        assertEquals(true, controlsExpandedAfterScroll(true, 0f, -1f))
        assertEquals(false, controlsExpandedAfterScroll(false, 12f, 3f))
        assertEquals(true, controlsExpandedAfterScroll(true, Float.NaN, -10f))
    }

}

package com.v2ray.ang.ui.main

import com.v2ray.ang.dto.entities.SubscriptionUsageInfo
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNull
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test

class MainSubscriptionInfoTest {
    private val now = 1_000_000_000_000L // ms

    @Test
    fun limitedTrafficComputesFraction() {
        val model = buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(upload = 100, download = 300, total = 1000), now)
        assertEquals(400, model.usedBytes)
        assertEquals(0.4f, model.trafficFraction!!, 0.0001f)
        assertFalse(model.trafficLow)
    }

    @Test
    fun unlimitedTrafficHasNoFraction() {
        val model = buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(download = 5), now)
        assertEquals(0L, model.totalBytes)
        assertNull(model.trafficFraction)
        assertFalse(model.trafficLow)
    }

    @Test
    fun overUsageIsClampedAndFlaggedLow() {
        val model = buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(download = 2000, total = 1000), now)
        assertEquals(1f, model.trafficFraction!!, 0.0001f)
        assertTrue(model.trafficLow)
    }

    @Test
    fun expiryIsConvertedToMillisAndFlaggedWhenPast() {
        val future = buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(expire = now / 1000 + 60), now)
        assertEquals(now + 60_000, future.expireMillis)
        assertFalse(future.expired)
        assertTrue(buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(expire = now / 1000 - 1), now).expired)
    }

    @Test
    fun zeroExpireMeansNeverExpires() {
        val model = buildSubscriptionInfoUiModel(SubscriptionUsageInfo(expire = 0), now)
        assertNull(model.expireMillis)
        assertFalse(model.expired)
    }
}
